prefix.f: bind-key -T prefix f display-popup -E -h "60%" -w "60%" "  (tmux list-sessions -F '[session] #S (#{session_windows} wins)';    tmux list-windows -a -F '[window] #S:#I #W') |   fzf --reverse --header='Switch Session/Window' --preview='tmux capture-pane -ep -t {2}' --preview-window=right:50% |   awk '{print $2}' |   xargs -I{} tmux switch-client -t {}"
prefix.y: bind-key -T prefix y new-window -c "#{pane_current_path}" -n files "exec yazi"
prefix.?: bind-key -T prefix ? display-menu -T "#[align=centre,bold]#[fg=#89dceb,align=centre,bold]tmux actions · Esc closes#[align=centre,bold]" -x C -y C "Yazi file browser (leader+y)" y "new-window -n files -c \"#{pane_current_path}\" \"exec yazi\"" +Sessions s "show-wk-menu #{@wk_menu_sessions}" +Windows w "show-wk-menu #{@wk_menu_windows}" +Panes p "show-wk-menu #{@wk_menu_panes}" "+Resize pane" r "show-wk-menu #{@wk_menu_resizepane}" "+Copy and paste" c "show-wk-menu #{@wk_menu_copyandpaste}" '' "Full shortcut cheat sheet" ? "display-popup -E -w 88% -h 85% -T \" tmux shortcuts · q closes \" \"less -R ~/.config/tmux/shortcuts.txt\"" "All live key bindings" B list-keys

root.C-h: bind-key -T root C-h if-shell "ps -o state= -o comm= -t '#{pane_tty}' | grep -iqE '^[^TXZ ]+ +(\\S+\\/)?g?(view|n?vim?x?)(diff)?$'" "send-keys C-h" "select-pane -L"
root.C-j: bind-key -T root C-j if-shell "ps -o state= -o comm= -t '#{pane_tty}' | grep -iqE '^[^TXZ ]+ +(\\S+\\/)?g?(view|n?vim?x?)(diff)?$'" "send-keys C-j" "select-pane -D"
root.C-k: bind-key -T root C-k if-shell "ps -o state= -o comm= -t '#{pane_tty}' | grep -iqE '^[^TXZ ]+ +(\\S+\\/)?g?(view|n?vim?x?)(diff)?$'" "send-keys C-k" "select-pane -U"
root.C-l: bind-key -T root C-l if-shell "ps -o state= -o comm= -t '#{pane_tty}' | grep -iqE '^[^TXZ ]+ +(\\S+\\/)?g?(view|n?vim?x?)(diff)?$'" "send-keys C-l" "select-pane -R"
